parts:

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : 
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself,

running command '"C:/Users/Documents/R/win-library/3.4/INLA/bin/windows/64bit/inla.exe"  -b -s -v  -t 1  "C:/Users/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpG8OFxi/file19407c6d6936/Model.ini"' had status 3 

2. How do I implement a varying coefficent model in INLA?

Many thanks
